newsitem.title: USA: GranCare holders approve merger, spinoff.
newsitem.headline: GranCare holders approve merger, spinoff.

text.p: GranCare Inc said on Monday that its shareholders have approved the merger of GranCare's institutional pharmacy business with Vitalink Pharmacy Services Inc and the spinoff of GranCare's skilled nursing and other businesses.
GranCare anticipates that these transactions will close on or about February 12, 1997, the company said.

In connection with the anticipated closing, GranCare also said it has extended the expiration date of its cash tender offer and consent solicitation for its outstanding 9-3/8 prcent senior subordinated notes due 2005 through February 11, 1997, the company said.
The purchase price per $1,000 principal amount of notes validly tendered is $1,090 plus accrued and unpaid interest up to, but not including, the payment date, the company said.
As of February 7, 1997, approximately $98 million in aggregate principal amount of notes, or about 98 percent of the principal, had been validly tendered, GranCare said.
